start: Gym tab, My gym, joined member at the desk, camera allowed

steps.action: Tap 'Check in' ('Scan the gym's check-in QR at the desk to mark today's visit')
user_sees: Screen 'Scan the gym poster', camera with a frame, 'Point your camera at the QR code on the poster at your gym's desk.'
must_not: A photo taken or saved
A black square with no words

steps.action: Point at the gym's check-in QR
user_sees: The check-in screen opens in place of the scanner
must_not: Two check-in screens from one QR
The scanner still open behind it

start: Scanner, wrong QR and camera refused

steps.action: Point at a QR that is not a MettleUp poster
user_sees: 'Wrong QR code. Scan the MettleUp poster at your gym's desk.' in amber, back to the normal line after a few seconds; scanning goes on
must_not: The QR's web page opened
The warning flashing on every frame

steps.action: Refuse the camera, then refuse for good
user_sees: 'MettleUp needs your camera to scan the poster and check you in.' with 'Allow camera'
Then 'Camera is off for MettleUp. Turn it on in Settings, or check in at the desk.' with 'Open Settings'
must_not: A prompt that pops up on every visit
A crash

user_sees: 'The camera didn't start. Close this screen and try again, or check in at the desk.'
must_not: An endless black box

start: Scanner, camera turned on in phone Settings and back

steps.action: Tap 'Open Settings', allow the camera, come back
user_sees: The camera shows without leaving the screen
must_not: The 'Camera is off' card still shown after it was allowed

start: Gym tab with no gym joined, or the welcome screen's gym code

steps.action: Tap 'Scan the poster' and point at a gym's invite QR
user_sees: The join screen for that gym (it asks before joining)
must_not: A join with no question
A check-in for a gym the member has not joined

steps.action: On the welcome screen, scan the poster
user_sees: The gym code filled and checked
must_not: The welcome screen leaving for another screen
